_: THE SEEDS. docs/PINS.md, docs/WELCOME.md §2. One pin Tari leaves in a room so its deck opens holding something. Signed Tari, spotless, level-less, replyable. All seventy-nine rooms covered as of 2026-08-30. Kacey's copy to redline — this is the app speaking in its own name and every line should sound like him, not like a generator.
stormwind-city: You can fish the canals. Most people have run past them a thousand times and never once cast.
ironforge: There is a museum in the Hall of Explorers and a plaque under everything in it. Nobody reads them.
orgrimmar: Thrall is upstairs in Grommash Hold and will be there all expansion. Worth walking up once while he still is.
darnassus: Almost nobody enters the Temple of the Moon unless a quest sends them. Go in and look up.
thunder-bluff: The lifts are slow. Ride one facing out.
undercity: The ring is one loop and every quarter hangs off it. Walk it once without opening the map.
elwynn-forest: You will out-level this in a weekend and never come back. Take one lap first.
dun-morogh: It snows the entire time you are here and nobody ever mentions it.
durotar: Red rock, no shade, and a coastline most people never see.
mulgore: The most peaceful zone in the game, and the one people leave fastest.
teldrassil: You are inside a tree. It stops being obvious after an hour, so notice it in the first one.
tirisfal-glades: The sky here is a colour that exists nowhere else in the game.
darkshore: The coast is the zone. Walk the shoreline instead of the road, once.
loch-modan: The dam is the landmark. The loch is the zone. Fish it.
silverpine-forest: Everything is grey on purpose. Turn the music up.
westfall: Sit through one sunset here. It costs nothing and it is the best in the game.
the-barrens: Everybody remembers the chat and nobody remembers the zone. Ride it end to end once with the sound on.
redridge-mountains: Stand on the bridge once and look at where you are. Then go back to killing gnolls.
stonetalon-mountains: There is a peak at the top of this zone with half of Kalimdor under it.
ashenvale: It is enormous and almost nobody walks the north half.
duskwood: The fog never lifts and it never gets brighter. Somebody chose that.
hillsbrad-foothills: Southshore and Tarren Mill are twenty seconds apart. That is the entire story of this zone.
wetlands: Everyone sprints the road because of the raptors. Walk it once instead.
thousand-needles: The mesas are the point. Look up rather than forward.
alterac-mountains: Barely anybody quests here, which is a reason to come rather than a reason to skip it.
arathi-highlands: Open, windy and mostly empty. Bring a fishing pole.
desolace: It is named honestly. Come anyway, once.
ragefire-chasm: Twenty minutes, directly under Orgrimmar, and most players never set foot in it.
the-deadmines: The ship at the end is a real ship. People kill Cookie and leave without ever looking up at it.
wailing-caverns: Everybody gets lost in here. Getting lost is most of it.
shadowfang-keep: Do not pull the courtyard from the ramp.
blackfathom-deeps: Half of it is underwater, and the underwater half is the reason to come.
razorfen-kraul: A maze made out of thorns. The wrong turns are the good part.
the-stockade: It is under the Stormwind canals, it takes fifteen minutes, and most players never go in.
gnomeregan: Everybody hates it. Do it once anyway, slowly, and read the names on the machines.
stranglethorn-vale: Everybody remembers this zone for the ganking. Ride the coast road south once instead of the inland one and see what it was supposed to be.
scarlet-monastery: Four wings, and most people only ever run two of them. The Library is the one worth slowing down in.
badlands: Nothing grows here and the sky is enormous. It is the emptiest ground in the Eastern Kingdoms and it rewards crossing slowly.
dustwallow-marsh: Barely anybody quests here and the zone is nearly empty. That is exactly why it is worth an afternoon.
swamp-of-sorrows: It rains the whole time and nobody stays. Stay.
razorfen-downs: The same thorns as the Kraul, gone bad. Look at what happened to the place between the two.
feralas: The greenest zone in the game, and half of it is coastline nobody has any reason to visit.
uldaman: This is where the dwarves found out where dwarves came from. Read what is on the walls before you leave.
tanaris: A pirate town, a dinosaur graveyard and a hole in time. Most people only ever see the road between them.
the-hinterlands: The gryphon riders live up here. Go and see where they keep them.
searing-gorge: The sky is orange and it never changes. Stand still for a second before you get to work.
zul-farrak: The top of the pyramid is worth stopping on. Everybody runs straight down the steps.
azshara: The most beautiful zone almost nobody has a reason to enter. That is the reason.
blasted-lands: This ground is what a portal does when it opens too wide. The Portal is still standing at the end of it.
maraudon: The purple half and the orange half are two different places. Do not skip the purple.
felwood: It was Ashenvale once. You can still see the shape of the forest under what happened to it.
un-goro-crater: Dinosaurs in a volcano crater, and a crystal puzzle almost nobody finishes. Take the long way round the rim.
the-temple-of-atal-hakkar: The Atal'ai built it, Ysera dropped it into the marsh, and they carried on using it anyway.
blackrock-depths: It is a city, not a dungeon. There is a working bar in it. Buy a drink before you fight anybody.
burning-steppes: This was a forest until a dwarf summoned something he could not hold. The Ironforge story ends here.
moonglade: No quests worth rushing and almost nothing to kill. The only zone in the game built for standing still.
western-plaguelands: Look at the farms. Every one of them has a name and used to belong to somebody.
dire-maul-east: The elves who lived here starved for magic and made themselves worse. The place is still beautiful.
eastern-plaguelands: The Scarlet Crusade and the Scourge are both in this zone and both want you dead. Nobody here is on your side.
silithus: The war effort ended here. Whatever your whole server carried, it was carried to this zone.
winterspring: It snows without stopping. Everyone comes for the mine and leaves; the frostsabers are worth the walk.
deadwind-pass: One road, no town, no quests, and a tower nobody has ever been inside. Ride through it slowly.
dire-maul-north: The tribute run is the thing everybody talks about and almost nobody actually does.
dire-maul-west: Somebody wrote every book in here. Open one.
lower-blackrock-spire: The biggest dungeon most people never finish. Two hours if you take it properly.
stratholme: This is the city Arthas culled. You are walking through the crime.
scholomance: It is a school. Read the names of the rooms.
upper-blackrock-spire: Somebody in the group has to have earned the key. Look out over the mountain once before you pull anything.
molten-core: Forty people and a great deal of waiting. The waiting was most of it, and most people remember it fondly.
blackwing-lair: Nefarian is running his father's experiments again. The eggs are the evidence.
ahn-qiraj: A war was fought to open this gate, by the whole server, over weeks. Nobody has ever had to do that again.
naxxramas: Hardly anybody saw the inside of this before it was taken away. You are early.
onyxia-s-lair: She is the one who was standing next to the throne in Stormwind.
ruins-of-ahn-qiraj: The open half. Twenty people, and the only raid you walk into under the sky.
zul-gurub: Bring a fishing pole into a raid once. There is a boss down there that will not come up any other way.
blackrock-mountain: Both factions keep a camp inside the same mountain. Go and stand on the chain and look down.
gadgetzan: Neutral ground in the middle of a desert. Alliance and Horde use the same bank and nobody says anything.
northshire: Everybody started somewhere like this. Come back at sixty and look at how small it is.
ratchet: The first neutral town most Horde players ever see, and the boat off Kalimdor. People wait here.
